name: ES React Components
tagline: Modular, Physical 3D Micro-Depth UI Component Suite for React 19
summary: A bespoke, production-ready React 19 component library engineered specifically for the ElseSourav ecosystem. Features instant CSS variable theme switching, physical sunken wells and 3D keycaps, Sonner-style kinetic toasts, and zero-runtime Tailwind styling.

meta.cssFramework: Tailwind CSS 3.4 + HSL CSS Custom Properties

architecturePhilosophy.purpose: Developed specifically to serve as the unified design backbone across all ElseSourav web apps and platforms (elsesourav.com), ensuring consistent interaction models, tactile physical depth, and instant real-time theme adaptability.

themeEngine.strategy: 100% CSS Custom Property token binding. No CSS-in-JS runtime overhead.

architecturePhilosophy.tactileDepth: Physical 1.5px depression travel on active states, specular 1px top-hairline highlights, sunken inner well shadows (mat-well), and authentic hardware deck tactile keycaps.

provenanceAndModifications.statement: While selected foundational patterns and accessibility contracts draw inspiration from reputable open-source libraries, every primitive in this library has been heavily refactored, custom-styled, and re-architected to seamlessly integrate with the ElseSourav design token system and tactile 3D guidelines.

adaptations.modification: Engineered proprietary CSS elevation tokens (--shadow-lift, --shadow-well, --shadow-cap) combined with active 1.5px translate-y depressions and specular top borders, creating a modern, subtle physical depth without heavy blur artifacts.
Refactored all component templates to consume reactive HSL and hex CSS custom properties, allowing live theme customizers to update the entire application in real time without virtual DOM re-renders.
Rebuilt with 100% solid, non-transparent surface tokens, tactile drop shadows, bidirectional swipe inertia, and customizable position docks (bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, etc.).

Engineered custom aspect ratio presets (including 21:9 Ultrawide, 16:9 Landscape, 1:1 Square, 3:4 Portrait, 9:16 Story), integrated clipboard image paste (Cmd+V), and responsive desktop modal viewport scaling.
Unified all 5 chart primitives (Line, Bar, Area, Donut, Stream) under a monochromatic high-contrast visual identity that dynamically reflects active CSS theme accent tokens.
